scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run check && vite build && cp dist/index.html dist/404.html
scripts.build:wasm: mkdir -p public/wasm && curl -L -o public/wasm/algraf.wasm https://github.com/williamcotton/algraf/releases/latest/download/algraf-wasm-latest.wasm && curl -L -o public/wasm/pdl.wasm https://github.com/williamcotton/pdl/releases/latest/download/pdl-wasm-latest.wasm && cp node_modules/sql.js/dist/sql-wasm.wasm public/wasm/sql-wasm.wasm
scripts.copy:wasm: mkdir -p public/wasm && cp ../algraf/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/algraf_wasm.wasm public/wasm/algraf.wasm && cp ../pdl/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/pdl_wasm.wasm public/wasm/pdl.wasm && cp node_modules/sql.js/dist/sql-wasm.wasm public/wasm/sql-wasm.wasm
